_notes: T2.54 Step-5 escalation queue: every live pair on which the two blind passes and the recorded label did not all agree. Owner adjudicates per LABELLING.md (retire-and-replace for wrong labels, rule-then-pairs for ambiguous rules). label_source stays 'author' for queued pairs until resolved.

escalations.premise: haproxy load-balances incoming requests across the three app nodes.
escalations.hypothesis: The three app nodes load-balance requests across haproxy instances.
escalations.recorded_rationale: Reversed functional role. The premise does not assert the reverse arrangement, but nothing in it excludes a separate one either, so this is unsupported, not contradicted (reversal rule, non-exclusive case).

pass_a.rule: reversal rule (balancer/backend roles cannot swap for one flow)

pass_b.rule: reversal rule (balancer/backend roles for one traffic flow cannot carry both directions)

escalations.recorded_rationale: Replaced-object swap (sentry -> mkdocs) with the sentence shape preserved; the one thing a named replacement retired is a single-valued slot (the exclusive-slot rule's 'one thing a named migration replaced' shape), so the differing value contradicts under the exclusive-slot rule. mkdocs is corpus-plausible as a replaced tool - it is genuinely replaced (by astro) in the harvest world.
